<description>
After #35531, each txindex entry now points to the block hash containing the tx instead of the file location of the block. The block hash is then used to find the file position of the block to read the tx from. This allows us to determine the hash of the containing block even if the block is later pruned, and also determine the location of the block on disk if it is later downloaded again via `getblockfrompeer`.

This PR enables maintaining a txindex while pruned. If a txid lookup tries to read a tx from a pruned block, the hash of the missing block is surfaced to the caller.

If desired, a user may call `getblockfrompeer` using the returned hash to download the block, then try again successfully. The downloaded block will be added to the front of the block queue, so won't be pruned again for at least 288 blocks. Of course a larger prune setting is desired if lots of historical blocks will be read, and there are privacy issues if the user is looking up their own transactions. Ideally the blocks can be fetched from a trusted node or from random peers with decoy blocks fetched occasionally.

Resolves https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/10609, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/12651, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/16182, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35240
</description>

<commits>
68e154438a rpc: handle missing undo data in getrawtransaction

Check for BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO before reading undo data for verbosity 2.

Return the transaction without fee and prevout when undo data is
unavailable, matching the documented behavior.

5d7f954442 rpc: allow optional data in JSONRPCError

Accept an optional data value and include it in the error object when
non-null. Preserve the existing response shape when no data is supplied.

9ab3eb2b6f txindex: allow prune mode when there are no legacy entries

591ff903b2 txindex: return pruned block hashes from FindTx

FindTx now returns a TxLookupResult so callers can distinguish a
missing transaction from one that may only be in pruned blocks.

281247bdb6 rpc: report pruned blocks from GetTransaction

Propagate lookup results through GetTransaction to RPC and REST callers.
Include candidate pruned block hashes in error messages and JSON-RPC
error.data, including the known block when gettxoutproof uses the UTXO
set. Callers can fetch missing blocks with getblockfrompeer and retry.

Adapt PSBT lookups to the new transaction lookup result type.

ff0d8880cf test: cover txindex lookups of pruned blocks

Extend the prune+txindex functional test to check that
getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST /tx return the pruned block hash,
and that utxoupdatepsbt skips those previous transactions until the
block is fetched.

c3de4d7dc7 doc: add release note for txindex pruning support
</commits>

+std::string PrunedBlocksErrorMessage(const std::set<uint256>& pruned_block_hashes)
+{
+    const std::string hashes{Join(pruned_block_hashes, ", ", [](const uint256& hash) { return hash.GetHex(); })};
+    if (pruned_block_hashes.size() == 1) {
+        return strprintf("Transaction may be in pruned block %s.", hashes);
+    }
+    return strprintf("Transaction may be in one of the following pruned blocks: %s.", hashes);
+}
+
+UniValue JSONRPCPrunedBlocksError(const std::set<uint256>& pruned_block_hashes)
+{
+    UniValue hashes{UniValue::VARR};
+    for (const auto& hash : pruned_block_hashes) {
+        hashes.push_back(hash.GetHex());
+    }
+    UniValue data{UniValue::VOBJ};
+    data.pushKV("pruned_block_hashes", std::move(hashes));
+    return JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, PrunedBlocksErrorMessage(pruned_block_hashes), data);
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-36002.md
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+Updated settings
+----------------
+
+- The transaction index (`-txindex`) can now be used with pruning (`-prune`).
+  The index must be built from genesis. Indexes built in a version prior to v32
+  must be rebuilt first. The transaction index continues to grow and does not
+  count toward the prune target. (#36002)
+
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+- `getrawtransaction` with verbosity 2 now omits `fee` and `prevout` instead of
+  returning an error when the block is available but its undo data is not,
+  e.g. after `getblockfrompeer`. (#36002)
+
+- With pruning enabled, `getrawtransaction` and `gettxoutproof` may return
+  error -1 when a transaction may be found in one or more pruned blocks.
+  Their hashes are returned in the error message and the
+  `error.data.pruned_block_hashes` array. The blocks are not guaranteed to contain
+  the transaction. This also applies without txindex for explicit block hashes
+  and `gettxoutproof` lookups through the UTXO set. (#36002)
+
+Updated REST API
+----------------
+
+- `/rest/tx/<TX-HASH>.<bin|hex|json>` now includes pruned block hashes in HTTP
+  404 errors when the transaction may be found in those blocks. (#36002)

+// Copyright (c) The Bitcoin Core developers

+// file COPYING or http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php.
+
+#ifndef BITCOIN_NODE_TX_LOOKUP_RESULT_H
+#define BITCOIN_NODE_TX_LOOKUP_RESULT_H
+
+#include <primitives/transaction.h>
+#include <uint256.h>
+
+#include <set>
+#include <variant>
+
+struct TxFound {
+    /// The transaction that was found.
+    CTransactionRef tx;
+    /// Hash of the block containing the transaction. null if the transaction
+    /// was found in the mempool.
+    uint256 block_hash;
+};
+
+struct TxMiss {
+    /// Only set when the transaction was not found but may exist in a pruned block.
+    /// Note that these blocks may be false positives and not contain the transaction.
+    std::set<uint256> pruned_block_hashes;
+};
+
+/// Result of a transaction lookup that may be answered by the txindex.
+struct TxLookupResult : public std::variant<TxFound, TxMiss>
+{
+    using variant::variant;
+
+    TxFound* GetFound() { return std::get_if<TxFound>(this); }
+    const TxFound* GetFound() const { return std::get_if<TxFound>(this); }
+    const TxMiss* GetMiss() const { return std::get_if<TxMiss>(this); }
+};
+
+#endif // BITCOIN_NODE_TX_LOOKUP_RESULT_H
